provenance.method: Authorship-breadth route added to prevent Books & media from remaining autism/ADHD-only.

question: Where can I inspect lived-experience books beyond autism and ADHD?
why_it_matters: A catalogue centred only on autism and ADHD can erase other neurodevelopmental perspectives.
current_understanding: The catalogue now includes bounded lived-experience routes for dyspraxia/DCD and Tourette syndrome as well as autism and ADHD. These are perspectives, not substitutes for condition guidance or evidence about everyone with the condition.
evidence_needed: Stable lived-experience book/media routes for DLD, dyslexia and learning disability that meet the same provenance and accessibility threshold.
reopening_conditions: New reviewed authorship broadens the catalogue or a current resource becomes unavailable.
dissent: Condition-specific memoir can provide recognition while still overrepresenting people able and willing to publish; absence from publishing is not absence of lived experience.
